text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During lunch one day, I notice a crowd
gathered
in the central plaza. Standing
in the center of all
the students holding
up their phones is...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: How do you guys like this?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Cute Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Here's a special pose just for you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Cute Curren Chan... Cute Curren Chan...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me! Can I post this on
Umastagram
with hashtag
"CuteCurrenChan"?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'd love that! ♪ Fill your
whole feed up
with me! ☆

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Cute Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The photo shoot seems to be quite a hit.
The air
is practically shimmering from
the heat of
everyone's enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, lunch is almost over! Time really
flies when
I'm hanging out with all of
you.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! But we haven't all got a
picture with
you yet!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I know. I wanna take pics with everyone
too...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's a great idea! ☆
choice_data_list: 整列して効率よく撮影しよう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's line up so we can take photos efficiently!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
We'll take more selfies next time! ♪
Everybody,
gather around for a
bird's-eye pic! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
We can take one with this drone the
director lent
me! ♪ Come on, you get
over here too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Say cheese! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flash!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like she has quite a way with
people.
Everyone loved the photo shoot!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, can I count on you to
gather
everyone up for me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Everybody! Line up in front of me,
please! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And you're the last person! ♪ Thanks for
coming
today! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that was amazing! I think everyone
felt the
cuteness! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I knew I could count on you! ☆ Ehehe,
thanks for
the help! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, we manage to finish the
photo shoot
by the end of lunch period.
Curren Chan looks
quite pleased!
